description:
### US-018: Back-office app shell — staff see the venue list
**As** staff, **I want** a back-office web app where I can see the organizer's venues and their GA capacity, **so that** later slices have a surface to author seat maps on. **Priority:** P2 **Depends on:** —

This is the prefactor slice: it stands up a new back-office web app and its gateway route, de-risking the new-app plumbing (framework, pnpm workspace, OpenAPI codegen, gateway routing, Compose wiring, healthcheck) **separately** from any seat-map domain logic. No seat-map code here — it renders venues that already exist.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A new `web/backoffice` app is added to the pnpm workspace and starts under `docker compose up` with a `/healthz` (or equivalent liveness) that the Compose healthcheck gates on; stack matches an existing precedent (storefront Astro+React **or** scanner React+Vite) — the plan picks one with a one-line rationale.
- [ ] The gateway route table gains a back-office prefix (e.g. `/admin/`) proxying to the new app, added alongside the existing `/api/catalog/` and `/` routes without breaking longest-prefix matching; the storefront catch-all `/` still resolves.
- [ ] Catalog exposes a venue **read** the back-office consumes: `GET /venues` (list) and/or `GET /venues/{id}` returning at least `{id, name, ga_capacity}`, `organizer_id`-scoped, with an ADR-004 `Cache-Control` tier declared (hours tier — venue geometry is long-lived) and the OpenAPI contract published (ADR-009).
- [ ] The back-office renders the venue list from that endpoint via generated types; opening `/admin/` in a browser shows the seeded organizer's venues with GA capacity (screenshot in the PR).
- [ ] The M1 storefront and scanner paths are untouched (their smoke tests stay green).

**Quality gates (every story):**
- `make check` green (lint + unit + integration + smoke; mirrors CI)
- Contract tests pass for any touched service boundary (ADR-009 drift check)
- New/changed public read endpoints declare an ADR-004 TTL tier with rationale
- New migrations run out-of-band via the service `migrate` subcommand (ADR-022) and build within the 30s startup budget with plain `CREATE INDEX` (ADR-020)
- Every owned entity is `organizer_id`-scoped (ADR-002)

Parent epic: TKT-3. Full lineage: docs/product/prd-v1.md §Capability map (TKT-3).

binding.rule: Every public read endpoint declares a volatility-tiered `Cache-Control`/`s-maxage`. Venue/seat-map geometry is the 'hours' tier (longer-lived than the 'minutes' event tier); availability is 'seconds'; hold/order state is never cached. Writes are never cached.
Every owned entity carries an `organizer_id` (tenant-aware) even though v1 has one organizer.

governingAdrs.why: The new venue read must declare the 'hours' geometry TTL tier, not the events 'minutes' tier.
Storefront-shell precedent (Astro) — reuse its scaffolding shape if the plan picks Astro; scanner is the React+Vite alternative.
Contract-first: the new venue GET is an OpenAPI addition, codegen'd into the back-office types.
Venue reads and the app are organizer-scoped from birth.

reference.summary: PRD v1 §Capability map — TKT-3 row is the source of truth for scope
TKT-3 epic — COS: authoring UI, versioning safe against sold inventory, GA+seated coexist
Gateway route table — add the /admin prefix here; longest-prefix wins, catch-all `/` last
Storefront = Astro+React public reads; scanner = React+Vite SPA — the two stack precedents

# TKT-101 execution plan — back-office shell + venue list

## 1. DoD (maps to COS)

| COS | Done condition |
|---|---|
| 1 | `web/backoffice` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`; `backoffice` compose service builds, `/healthz` returns 200, healthcheck gates; `make check` green. |
| 2 | Gateway `routes` gains `"/admin/": "BACKOFFICE_URL"` (NOT path-stripped, like `/scanner/`); `GET /admin/` proxies to the app; `/` still resolves to storefront. |
| 3 | Catalog `GET /public/venues` returns `[{id, organizer_id, name, ga_capacity, created_at}]` scoped by `organizer_id`, `Cache-Control` hours tier, in `openapi.yaml`, codegen clean. |
| 4 | `/admin/` SSR-renders the seeded venues via `api-types.gen.ts` types; screenshot in PR. |
| 5 | Storefront + scanner smoke green. |

## 2. Chosen stack + rationale

**Astro 7 SSR + React** (`@astrojs/node` standalone), copying `web/storefront`'s real scaffolding — **minus i18n** (staff tool, single locale; drop `i18n.routing`, `redirects`, `src/locales`). Confirmed owner's shaping decision. The scanner React+Vite+nginx alternative is viable but loses: the back-office's next stories (seat-map authoring) are SSR/data-loading heavy, and reusing the storefront's `api.ts`/`cache.ts`/`middleware.ts` pattern beats re-deriving it on Vite. One-line: storefront shape reused, i18n stripped.

## 3. Read-path design decision — **(a) `/public/venues`**

Recommend **(a)**, not the ticket's literal bare `GET /venues`.

- **Why not (b)** bare `/venues` GET: the codebase has exactly two read conventions — `/public/...` (cached, unauthenticated) and `/internal/...` (`X-Internal-Token`). A third bare-read convention is a new precedent for no gain, and `/venues` already hosts `createVenue` POST; adding GET there mixes the trusted-write and cached-read surfaces on one path.
- **Why not (c)** `/internal/venues` + gateway token injection: the gateway currently injects no credentials and `/internal/` is explicitly 404'd at the gateway (`main.go:103`). Wiring token injection is new gateway machinery this prefactor slice shouldn't own.
- **Why (a):** matches the only existing cached-read convention; the back-office is unauthenticated today anyway (no admin auth in scope); the gateway already proxies `/api/catalog/public/...` to catalog with zero new machinery. When admin auth lands, `/public/venues` can be re-scoped or the back-office moved behind a token — a documented follow-up, not a blocker.

**Exact contract:**
- Route: `GET /public/venues` → operationId `listPublicVenues`, query param `organizer_id` (uuid, required) — scoping is explicit, not inferred (ADR-002), and there's no session to infer from.
- Response `200`: array of `Venue` (reuse the existing schema verbatim — all five required fields). New schema `PublicVenueList` = `{ venues: [Venue] }` or bare `[Venue]`; pick **bare array** to match `PublicEventList` style only if that's an array — check: `PublicEventList` is an object; follow it with `{ venues: [...] }` for forward-compat (pagination later). **Decide: object wrapper `{ venues: [Venue] }`.**
- Cache-Control: **new constant** in `server.go`: `CacheControlPublicVenueReads = "public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=3600"` (hours tier, ADR-004 — venue geometry is long-lived). Declare the `Cache-Control` response header in the spec (mirror line 450-452 pattern).
- **ADR-028:** handler must emit `organizer_id`, `created_at` (RFC3339), all required fields, exact field names — response is validated against the spec and 500s on drift. The codegen'd `Venue` model is the source of truth for the payload.

## 4. Files to add/change

**Catalog spec + gen:**
- `services/catalog/api/openapi.yaml` — add `/public/venues` GET (after `/public/festivals/{id}` block, ~line 540); add `PublicVenueList` schema; declare Cache-Control header. Add `OrganizerId` query param component.
- `services/catalog/internal/api/openapi_gen.go` — regenerated via `make generate` (never hand-edit).

**Catalog handler + store:**
- `services/catalog/internal/api/server.go` — add `CacheControlPublicVenueReads` const (~line 39); implement generated `ListPublicVenues` handler setting the hours-tier header, scoping by `organizer_id`.
- `services/catalog/internal/store/store.go` — add `ListVenues(ctx, organizerID uuid.UUID) ([]Venue, error)` to `Store` interface (~line 285).
- `services/catalog/internal/store/postgres.go` — implement `ListVenues` (query style per `CreateVenue`: `SELECT id, organizer_id, name, ga_capacity, created_at FROM venues WHERE organizer_id=$1 ORDER BY name`).

**Migration:**
- `services/catalog/internal/store/migrations/0003_seed_default_venues.sql` — plain `INSERT INTO venues (organizer_id, name, ga_capacity) VALUES ('00000000-...-0001', ...)` ×2-3 rows + matching `Down` DELETE. No index (ADR-020 N/A). Runs via existing `catalog-migrate` compose job (ADR-022).

**Gateway:**
- `gateway/cmd/gateway/main.go` — add `"/admin/": "BACKOFFICE_URL"` to `routes` map (:30); keep `/` last. No strip logic change (non-`/api/` so not stripped — correct).

**New app `web/backoffice`:**
- `package.json` — name `backoffice`, scripts mirror storefront (`generate:api` → `src/lib/api-types.gen.ts` from catalog spec), deps: astro/@astrojs/node/@astrojs/react/react/openapi-typescript/vitest/oxlint/typescript.
- `astro.config.mjs` — `output:'server'`, node standalone adapter, `ssr.noExternal:true`, `base:'/admin'` (critical: serves under `/admin/`), **no i18n**, react integration.
- `src/pages/index.astro` — venue list page (SSR fetch + render).
- `src/pages/healthz.ts` — liveness `{status:'ok'}` no-store (copy storefront).
- `src/lib/api.ts` — `getVenues()` via `GATEWAY_URL/api/catalog/public/venues?organizer_id=...`.
- `src/lib/api-types.gen.ts` — generated.
- `Dockerfile` — copy storefront's (root context, `npm i -g pnpm@11.12.0`, `--filter backoffice`).
- `src/App.test.tsx` or `src/pages/index.test.tsx` — vitest render test (scanner precedent).

**Wiring:**
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` — add `web/backoffice` to `packages`.
- `compose.yaml` — add `backoffice` service (root context build, wget `/healthz` healthcheck, `GATEWAY_URL: http://gateway:8080`); add `BACKOFFICE_URL: http://backoffice:8080` to gateway env + `backoffice: {condition: service_healthy}` to gateway `depends_on`.
- `Makefile` `check-generate` (:34) — add `web/backoffice/src/lib/api-types.gen.ts` to the drift-check path list.

## 5. Test plan (TDD — RED first)

1. **Catalog handler test** (`server_test.go`): `TestListPublicVenues` — seed 2 venues for organizer A + 1 for organizer B via store, `GET /public/venues?organizer_id=A` returns exactly A's 2 with all five fields, correct `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=3600`. Also: missing/invalid `organizer_id` → 400. RED: 404 (route unregistered).
2. **Store test** (wherever `CreateVenue` is tested — `postgres` integration test seam): `ListVenues` returns only the scoped organizer's rows. RED: method undefined (compile fail).
3. **Gateway route**: no `gateway/*_test.go` exists. **Decision: cover via smoke** — add a smoke assertion rather than introduce a new gateway unit-test harness in a prefactor slice. (Flag to reviewer: cheap to add a `main_test.go` asserting `routes["/admin/"] == "BACKOFFICE_URL"`; optional.)
4. **Back-office render test** (vitest, scanner `App.test.tsx` precedent): mock `api.ts`, render list, assert venue names + GA capacities appear. RED: page/component doesn't exist.
5. **Smoke (end-to-end proof)**: extend `smoke/` — `GET gateway:8080/api/catalog/public/venues?organizer_id=<default>` returns seeded venues (proves migration + handler + contract), and `GET /admin/` returns 200 HTML containing a seeded venue name (proves gateway proxy + SSR render through the real stack). ADR-028 drift is caught here, not in unit tests.

## 6. Risks / traps

- **ADR-028 drift 500**: `created_at` must serialize RFC3339; `organizer_id` required and present; field names exact. A mismatch passes unit tests (if the test hand-builds expected JSON loosely) but 500s live — the smoke contract test is the real guard. Build the response from the codegen'd `Venue` type, not a hand-rolled map.
- **`check-generate` fails** if the spec is edited without rerunning `make generate` — and the Makefile drift list (:34) must include the new backoffice gen file or backoffice drift is unchecked.
- **`base: '/admin'`**: Astro must serve under `/admin/` since the gateway doesn't strip; a missing `base` renders the app at `/` and every asset link 404s behind the proxy. Asset paths must respect `base`.
- **Longest-prefix**: `/admin/` vs `/` — `http.ServeMux` handles it; keep `/` last in the map literal for readability (map iteration is random, ServeMux ordering is what actually governs).
- **Node 25+ corepack**: Dockerfile must `npm i -g pnpm@11.12.0`, not `corepack enable` (storefront already encodes this — copy it).
- **Hours-tier value**: don't reuse `CacheControlPublicReads` (minutes); new constant, exact value `public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=3600`.
- **Migration ordering**: `0003` must sort after `0002` (organizer FK). Goose runs in filename order; `ORDER BY name` in `ListVenues` keeps output deterministic for tests/screenshot.
- **`PublicVenueList` wrapper vs array**: pick wrapper now; changing later is a contract revision.

## 7. Sequencing (gate stays green incrementally)

1. **Migration** `0003_seed_default_venues.sql` (green: existing migrate job runs it).
2. **Spec + codegen**: add `/public/venues` to `openapi.yaml`, `make generate`, add backoffice gen path to `check-generate` — but backoffice gen file doesn't exist yet, so **defer the Makefile edit to step 5** or create the app skeleton first. Recommended: app skeleton (step 5) codegen target created before wiring `check-generate`.
3. **Store** `ListVenues` (RED store test → implement → green).
4. **Handler** `ListPublicVenues` + hours-tier const (RED handler test → implement → green). Catalog fully green here.
5. **`web/backoffice` skeleton**: package.json, astro.config (`base:'/admin'`), healthz.ts, empty index.astro, Dockerfile, `generate:api`; add to `pnpm-workspace.yaml`; `pnpm install`; now add gen file to `check-generate` and run `make generate`. Lint/build green.
6. **Back-office feature**: `api.ts` + `index.astro` + render test (RED → green).
7. **Gateway route** + **compose** service + `depends_on`/`BACKOFFICE_URL`.
8. **Smoke assertions** (venues endpoint + `/admin/` 200 with venue name).
9. `make check` full green; manual browser screenshot of `/admin/` for the PR.

Steps 1–4 land catalog independently; 5–6 land the app independently; 7–8 wire them; nothing breaks mid-sequence because the gateway route and compose service only appear once both ends exist.

---

**Open questions for the reviewer:** (i) `/public/venues` vs the ticket's literal `/venues` — I chose (a), overrule if the ticket text is binding; (ii) `PublicVenueList` object wrapper vs bare array; (iii) gateway unit test vs smoke-only coverage.

objective.note: Staff have no surface to view/author venues; this stands up the back-office app so later seat-map slices have a home. Prefactor that de-risks new-app plumbing away from domain logic.

scope.note: IN: new web/backoffice app (Astro+React) in the pnpm workspace + Compose + healthcheck; gateway /admin route; catalog venue read (GET /venues[/{id}]); render the venue list. OUT: any seat-map model/authoring (TKT-102+), auth/RBAC beyond what M1 has, editing.

uncertainties.note: Gateway longest-prefix interaction with the /admin route and the catch-all '/' — verified pattern exists in gateway/cmd/gateway/main.go; plan confirms ordering. No product unknowns.

dependencies.note: None — first slice in the chain. Extends existing catalog venues + gateway route table; no blocked-by links.

approach.note: OWNER DECISION 2026-07-20: back-office = Astro+React, matching the storefront (ADR-006) precedent. Add /admin to the gateway route table; catalog gains an organizer-scoped venue GET (OpenAPI/ADR-009) at the ADR-004 hours tier; back-office renders via generated types.

first_slice.note: The whole ticket IS the first slice: shell + one working read-only page (venue list). Demoable via a browser screenshot at /admin.

success.note: COS: `docker compose up` brings up web/backoffice with a passing healthcheck; /admin proxies to it; the seeded organizer's venues+GA capacity render from the catalog read; storefront/scanner smoke green.

context_memo.note: Baked at decomposition: ADR-004 (hours tier), ADR-006 (Astro precedent), ADR-009 (contract-first), ADR-002 (tenancy). governingAdrs present.
